Radekhiv Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · L'vivs'ka oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Radekhiv's Jewish community, present from the mid-18th century, was home to a Hasidic court founded by Naftali-Zvi Rubin (1848–1900) in the late 19th century, and the Belz and Gusiatin Hasidic streams later dominated locally. In 1918, the Zionist association Kadima opened a library and drama club. In late June 1941, about 500 Jews moved to Radekhiv from the bombed town of Kholoev (present-day Nodal); on September 15, 1942, around 1,400 Jews were deported from Radekhiv to the Bełżec extermination camp.
